# SPDX-License-Identifier: MIT
# The MP3 player app: the track list from library, playback from player, the screen kept current
# by the page's timer.

import lvgl as lv

import library
import player

ACCENT = lv.color_hex(0x2F6FDE)
ROW = lv.color_hex(0x1E2633)
# Shown in the Studio simulator, which has no music folder.
DEMO = [("demo/1.mp3", "Morning Light", "Demo Band"), ("demo/2.mp3", "City Rain", "Demo Band"),
        ("demo/3.mp3", "Long Road Home", "Demo Trio"), ("demo/4.mp3", "Night Train", "Demo Trio")]

_ui = None
_player = player.Player()
_tracks = []
_rows = []
_shown = None


def _clock(seconds):
    seconds = int(seconds)
    return "%d:%02d" % (seconds // 60, seconds % 60)


def _row_font():
    # List rows follow the screen: bigger letters on an 800x480 screen than on a 480x272 one.
    height = lv.display_get_default().get_vertical_resolution()
    return lv.font_montserrat_24 if height >= 400 else lv.font_montserrat_14


def _caption(button, text):
    button.get_child(0).set_text(text)


def start(ui):
    global _ui, _tracks
    _ui = ui
    lv.screen_active().set_style_bg_color(lv.color_hex(0x121820), 0)
    _caption(ui.prev_button, lv.SYMBOL.PREV)
    _caption(ui.next_button, lv.SYMBOL.NEXT)
    _caption(ui.play_button, lv.SYMBOL.PLAY)
    _caption(ui.volume_down, lv.SYMBOL.VOLUME_MID)
    _caption(ui.volume_up, lv.SYMBOL.VOLUME_MAX)
    ui.track_list.set_style_border_width(0, 0)
    ui.track_list.set_style_radius(10, 0)
    ui.progress.set_style_bg_opa(255, 0)
    ui.track_list.set_style_pad_all(4, 0)
    ui.track_list.set_style_pad_row(4, 0)
    _tracks = library.tracks() or (DEMO if player.linuxproc is None else [])
    ui.track_list.clean()
    _rows.clear()
    for index, (_path, title, _artist) in enumerate(_tracks):
        row = lv.button(ui.track_list)
        row.set_width(lv.pct(100))
        row.set_style_bg_color(ROW, 0)
        row.set_style_shadow_width(0, 0)
        label = lv.label(row)
        label.set_text(title)
        label.set_style_text_font(_row_font(), 0)
        label.set_long_mode(lv.label.LONG_MODE.DOTS)
        label.set_width(lv.pct(100))
        row.add_event_cb(lambda e, i=index: play_track(i), lv.EVENT.CLICKED, None)
        _rows.append(row)
    if not _tracks:
        ui.title.set_text("No music")
        ui.artist.set_text("Copy .mp3 files to :" + library.MUSIC_DIR)
    show()


def play_track(index):
    _player.play([path for path, _title, _artist in _tracks], index)
    show()


def toggle():
    if not _tracks:
        return
    if not _player.playing:
        play_track(max(_player.index, 0))
    else:
        _player.toggle_pause()
    show()


def next_track():
    _player.next()
    show()


def previous_track():
    _player.previous()
    show()


def volume_up():
    _player.volume_up()
    show()


def volume_down():
    _player.volume_down()
    show()


def tick():
    _player.update()
    show()


def show():
    global _shown
    if _ui is None:
        return
    p = _player
    if p.index != _shown and 0 <= p.index < len(_tracks):
        _shown = p.index
        _path, title, artist = _tracks[p.index]
        _ui.title.set_text(title)
        _ui.artist.set_text(artist)
        for index, row in enumerate(_rows):
            row.set_style_bg_color(ACCENT if index == p.index else ROW, 0)
        _rows[p.index].scroll_to_view(True)
    _caption(_ui.play_button, lv.SYMBOL.PAUSE if p.playing and not p.paused else lv.SYMBOL.PLAY)
    if p.duration:
        _ui.progress.set_value(int(1000 * min(p.position / p.duration, 1)), False)
        _ui.elapsed.set_text("%s / %s" % (_clock(p.position), _clock(p.duration)))
    else:
        _ui.progress.set_value(0, False)
        _ui.elapsed.set_text(_clock(p.position) if p.playing else "")
    if p.error:
        _ui.elapsed.set_text(p.error)
    _ui.volume.set_text("Volume %d%%" % p.volume)
